death.note: doxologia.ro: «A păstorit credicioșii de la Gurile Dunării spre sfârșitul secolului al III-lea… Se crede că Sfântul Mucenic Evanghel a fost martirizat în timpul persecuției lui Dioclețian (284-305).» The page gives the reign and no year, and marks the martyrdom itself as believed rather than recorded.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 июля ст. ст. — «Мч. Евангела (ок. 284-305).»

attestations.note: The day’s fifth entry, and this folder’s man: the same menologion day its Romanian and Greek rows already keep, the same see. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE for him — the line links to his name and to no reading, and name page 662 prints «Святитель Евангел Томский (Кюстенджийский), епископ, сщмч.», «День памяти: 7 июля» and nothing else. The bracketed «(Кюстенджийский)» is the Turkish name of the city, Küstence, beside the ancient Tomis, and it is stored in the name form as the page prints it and used for nothing. `dates` UNCHANGED: the line’s «(ок. 284-305)» is Diocletian’s reign to the year, which is exactly the interval this folder already carries off doxologia.ro — the first independent witness to it. `types` and `office` UNCHANGED; this page grades him «sщмч.» where the line says «Мч.» and the folder holds `martyr, bishop`, and no `hieromartyr` was written on the name link alone. TWO ENTRIES OF THIS DAY WERE WITHHELD AND ARE NAMED IN THE REPORT: «Прп. Акакия , о котором повествуется в Лествице (VI).» is `acacius-the-obedient`, which already carries a VENERATED russian row on the Julian 29 ноября, and «Прп. Евфросинии, в миру Евдокии , кн. Московской (1407).» is `euphrosyne-of-moscow`, which already carries one on the Julian 17 мая, the day of her tonsure. BRIEF-RUSSIAN §4 forbids a draft on such a folder and BRIEF.md §4 sanctions a second-day note; the author has not ruled between them, so nothing was written for either and their hymns on this page were not copied.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Evanghel, Episcopul Tomisului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Ευάγγελος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and its whole account is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Ευάγγελος μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους». The identification rests on the day and the name alone, because saint.gr gives him no see and does not repeat the folder's Tomis; the corpus keeps no other Evangelus of any spelling, and a second folder for one man is the worse of the two errors, so the row is taken as his and this is said plainly. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
